name: 暗記カードの学習方式の設定シート
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 760 px Japanese flashcard-study settings component. Reference 1 is the authoritative Lighthouse native preview for layout, Japanese text, typography, control states, and spacing. Return the component canvas only, with no phone frame or surrounding app.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the full canvas pure white #FFFFFF and remove every pale mint, lavender, cream, gray, blue, or other tinted surface fill, gradient, glow, shadow, and texture. Preserve the four group-card bounds and 12 px corner radius, but make their fill pure white and add only a thin neutral #E5E5E5 outline so the groups remain clear on white. Use solid flat forest green #047857 for active switch tracks, neutral #E4E4E4 for inactive switch tracks, and white knobs. Use #1D1D1D for text and #6E6E6E for the close X and right chevron.

Match the 390 × 760 native layout exactly. Center the title “学習の設定” at x=48/y=16 in a 294×28 box, Meiryo Bold 20/28, near-black. Draw a simple neutral-gray close X at x=20/y=24, 12×12.

Group 1: rounded white card with neutral outline x=16/y=66, 358×152, 12 px radius. Section heading “基本” at x=32/y=82, 326×16, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “用語の順番を変える” at x=32/y=122, 252×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, with OFF switch at x=298/y=120, 54×30; neutral track, white 22×22 knob at x=302/y=124. Row “文章を読み上げる” at x=32/y=170 with OFF switch at x=298/y=168 and white knob at x=302/y=172.

Group 2: card x=16/y=236, 358×150. Heading “何を答えるか” x=32/y=248, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “用語を答える” x=32/y=290 with ON switch x=298/y=288 and white 22×22 knob x=324/y=292. Row “定義を答える” x=32/y=338 with ON switch x=298/y=336 and knob x=324/y=340. Both tracks flat solid #047857.

Group 3: card x=16/y=404, 358×202. Heading “問題の形式” x=32/y=416, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “暗記カード” x=32/y=458 with OFF switch x=298/y=456 and knob x=302/y=460. Row “選択問題” x=32/y=506 with ON switch x=298/y=504 and knob x=324/y=508. Row “記述問題” x=32/y=554 with OFF switch x=298/y=552 and knob x=302/y=556. Body labels are Meiryo Regular 14/24.

Group 4: card x=16/y=624, 358×116. Heading “答えの判定方法” x=32/y=640, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “意味が合っていれば正解” at x=32/y=680, 294×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, with a neutral-gray “〉” at x=338/y=680 in a 20×24 box. Preserve exact text, state selections, card spacing, and white gaps. Add no extra labels, dividers, artwork, or decoration.
reviewNotes: White and neutral card surfaces; active green tracks retain mild texture and will receive one flat-fill correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
